en: Dependent on a state that is unwholesome and associated with clinging (*upādāna*), there arises a state that is unwholesome but not associated with clinging, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.

Dependent on a state that is unwholesome and a defilement (*kilesa*), there arises a state that is unwholesome but not a defilement, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are five;
under object condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are five.
